documentation.title: Match Trailing Comma
documentation.standard:
For single-line match expressions, there should be no comma after the last arm.
For multi-line match expressions, there should be a comma after the last arm.

code.title: Valid: Single-line match expression without a comma after the last arm.
Invalid: Single-line match expression with a comma after the last arm.
Valid: Multi-line match expression with a comma after the last arm.
Invalid: Multi-line match expression without a comma after the last arm.
